subject: Chain-of-custody workflow and redaction approach for short-notice log pulls
messages:
From: Compliance <compliance@greenriverhealth.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-notice admin/log extract + chain-of-custody for SIG response

Hi Logan,

We need a short-notice export of admin activity and audit logs for an upcoming SIG questionnaire submission. The scope: account admin events, role changes, token creation/deletion, and API access attempts for the period 2028-07-01 through 2028-07-29.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you provide a time-stamped export with MD5/SHA256 checksums and a manifest showing file-level hashes?
- What chain-of-custody (CoC) artifacts do you produce by default for ad-hoc pulls?
- Do you redact PII by default in the admin payload, and how is redaction marked in the manifest?
- Preferred transfer: secure SFTP or presigned HTTPS URL? We have an SFTP endpoint but can accept pre-signed links for ingestion.

We may need the delivery within 24 business hours. Please confirm feasibility and estimated delivery timeline.

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Senior Compliance Manager
GreenRiver Health
compliance@greenriverhealth.com

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-excerpt.pdf

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Compliance <compliance@greenriverhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-notice admin/log extract + chain-of-custody for SIG response

Karen — thanks for the heads up. We can do this within the requested window but I want to align on the delivery and redaction expectations before we start any snapshot. High-level plan below; will follow with a signed transfer manifest once we agree: 

Planned deliverables:
- gzipped JSONL export (admin-activity namespace) split into day-chunks (approx 1GB/day) named admin-activity-snapshot-YYYYMMDD.jsonl.gz
- chain-of-custody manifest (CSV) with file name, SHA256, MD5, record count, export start/end timestamps, and operator ID
- signed HMAC of the manifest (we use HMAC-SHA256)
- optional redaction map (if PII redaction applied) showing redaction token IDs and rationale

Redaction policy:
- By default we do NOT redact admin action metadata fields (actor email, timestamp, action_type). We redact raw request payloads that may contain user-submitted PII (binary blobs, email bodies). Redactions are replaced with [REDACTED] placeholders and the manifest contains a redaction flag per file.

Transfer options:
- Preferred: SFTP (mutual auth) to your endpoint. If you prefer presigned URLs we can stage on a locked S3 path with 24h presigned PUT links.

Timeline (if we start immediately):
- T+6 hours: preliminary sample (first day chunk + manifest)
- T+16 hours: full export + signed manifest + checksums

Can you confirm SFTP hostname + thumbprint or indicate presigned URL preference? Also please confirm whether you require notarized timestamping or third-party notarization for the manifest (some customers request that for legal holds).

— Logan Wright
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

FW: operational details from extraction lead — adding S3/Snapshot notes.

On Mon, Jul 30, 2028 at 10:03 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Karen — thanks for the heads up. We can do this within the requested window but I want to align on the delivery and redaction expectations before we start any snapshot. High-level plan below; will follow with a signed transfer manifest once we agree: 
> 
> Planned deliverables:
> - gzipped JSONL export (admin-activity namespace) split into day-chunks (approx 1GB/day) named admin-activity-snapshot-YYYYMMDD.jsonl.gz

I ran a dry-run this morning against the July window — estimate ~18GB uncompressed, ~4.2GB gzipped split across seven chunks. Extraction script will:
- Snapshot read using timebox ID -> lock; prevents concurrent log mutation during export.
- Produce file-level SHA256 and MD5. We also create a line-count and earliest/latest event timestamp per file.
- If redaction requested, we apply the redaction pass prior to gzipping and include a redaction manifest: redaction-manifest-20280730.csv with columns file, field, redaction_type, reason.

Operator/event provenance: we will include operator_run_id and operator_email in the manifest. For CoC we produce: exporter_name, exporter_version, start_ts, end_ts, s3_path_or_destination, manifest_hash, hmac_signature, operator_run_id.

I will coordinate with Karthik for routing the S3 staging path and generating presigned links if the customer wants HTTPS. Karthik — do you want the staging prefix to be greenriver/shortnotice/2028-07-30/ ?

— Kim Park
Sr. Product Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: admin-activity-snapshot-contents.csv

From: Dinesh Patel <dinesh.patel@legalwrangle.com>

Cc: Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>, Compliance <compliance@greenriverhealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-notice admin/log extract + chain-of-custody for SIG response

Logan and team,

Thanks — a couple of legal/procurement asks from our side before transfer: 
- We require a manifest signed with both an HMAC-SHA256 (sender key) and a notarized timestamp (we accept RFC3161 timestamping). If Redwood can generate an RFC3161 timestamp token for the manifest, please include it.
- We prefer SFTP using public-key auth to your SFTP server. If you cannot support public-key, we will accept presigned HTTPS with client cert validation.
- Please include a mapping file that explains how redaction was applied (which fields replaced) and whether any sampling occurred.
- Retention expectations: for this SIG deliverable GreenRiver will keep the snapshot for 90 days; confirm Redwood's recommended retention on your side for exported artifacts and whether you support a certified deletion callback to the recipient.

Deliverables confirmed above are sufficient once we have the signed manifest and RFC3161 token.

Regards,
Dinesh Patel
Senior Counsel, LegalWrangle (on behalf of GreenRiver)
+1 (212) 555-0199

All — closing the loop. Confirmed plan and next steps below.

Scope: admin actions, role changes, token lifecycle events, API auth failures for 2028-07-01 -> 2028-07-29.

Exports & artifacts to be delivered (T+16 hours if we start now):
1) admin-activity-snapshot-20280730-part1.jsonl.gz ... part7.jsonl.gz (gzipped JSONL)
2) chain-of-custody-manifest-20280730.csv (file, sha256, md5, line_count, earliest_ts, latest_ts, operator_run_id)

Retention & deletion callback: Redwood will retain the exported artifacts in our staging bucket for up to 14 days by default. We can extend to 90 days for this delivery and provide a signed deletion callback (signed JSON manifest with deletion timestamp + HMAC). Please confirm if 90 days is required on Redwood's side — otherwise we will keep 14 days and provide the deletion callback when we purge.
